infobox.trader: Ragman LL3, after unlocking it in Season 1: KORD BREACH

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
Multiple accessories from various manufacturers are attached to the bag, including:
- Two Thyrm CellVault CR123 & AAA in the "Rescue" color variant
- A HydroFlask Wide Mouth 32oz Bottle in Tonal Black
- A Caranthia Expedition Cover Gore in Olive
- An Imminent Threat Solutions (ITS) Tallboy Trauma Pouch in Black
- Trauma Shears.

A patch at the top says "Mystery Brunch" rather than the Mystery Ranch brand

The Hydro Flask 32-ounce water bottle to the side of the backpack has a "Spiritus" sticker
